# Promise identifiers

<!-- generated by requirements/tools/assign-ids.py - do not edit by hand -->

A number is **never reused**, even when the promise it named is dropped:
a merge request or a verdict citing it must keep resolving to what it meant.

| id | promise |
|---|---|
| `@P-1` | A system-wide dark mode is available and respected |
| `@P-2` | The system works on both smartphones and tablets, in portrait and tablet orientation |
| `@P-3` | The system is usable in at least English, French, Spanish, German, and Italian |
| `@P-4` | A freshly flashed device contacts no Google server by default |
| `@P-5` | No telemetry is ever sent without the user's consent |
| `@P-6` | A blocked tracker never reaches the network |
| `@P-7` | Security patches ship monthly |
| `@P-8` | Security fixes are backported to older Android versions as soon as possible |
| `@P-9` | A device is kept secure and current for as long as reasonably possible |
| `@P-10` | Ordinary Android applications work as expected |
| `@P-11` | Carrier and operator services keep working |
| `@P-12` | The default set of applications is coherent and usable out of the box |
| `@P-13` | A user can still add and use a Google or Yahoo account |
| `@P-14` | The Murena Workspace account is a first-class part of the experience |
| `@P-15` | The UI and UX are reworked to be usable by a mainstream audience |
| `@P-16` | Default applications are pre-granted the permissions they need, and the user can always take them back |
